RecordMetadata.description: Strict capture metadata. kind is failure or inspection; replay_mode is required only for failures. occurred_at is the capture occurrence time. Retryable failures require snapshot and payload; non-retryable failures retain metadata only and use too_large or unsupported. Inspections are view-only, have no failure/destination fields or snapshot, and always use inspection_only as their retry prohibition. Missing payloads require payload_unavailable_reason too_large or unsupported independently of retry policy. Inspection payload format remains version 1. Text bounds, SHA256 validation, and exact artifact sizes are enforced at ingest.

note.description: Required nonblank evidence, valid UTF-8, at most 4096 bytes. Line breaks and tabs are allowed; other control characters are rejected. Text is preserved exactly.

reference.description: Optional printable UTF-8 receipt/reference, at most 1024 bytes. Empty or null means omitted; whitespace-only and controls are rejected. This is opaque text, not a URL Hookway opens.

result.description: Raw persisted JSON, including null for queued runs. Newly written result objects follow RunResult. Historical unknown keys and JSON are passed through unchanged.

bearerAuth.description: Named scoped replay bearer token. Scopes: capture, read, payload, retry, metrics. Required scope is declared on each operation.
